messages:
deploy-bot: Deployment v3.14.0 to staging finished. Triggering post-deploy smoke suite: smoke-e2e, synthetic-kvprobe, health-checks. Summary: smoke-e2e: PASS, synthetic-kvprobe: WARN (elevated 5xx on /embed), health-checks: PASS. Logs: https://ci.redwood/integrations/1779004321/smoke-report

elaine: saw the synthetic spike in the dashboard, is it still happening or was it a short blip?

miguel: reproducing now — I see a 4-6% 503 rate on /embed for a ~3 minute window starting 1779004280. Top offender: model-worker-27.

samir: interesting — we rolled the new model-serve binary to the pool and bumped mem-cache eviction threshold. did we change TTL anywhere? I only see the binary bump in the release notes.
\

sre-oncall: attaching probe snippet:```
embed probe: 1000 reqs
200 -> 949 (95.0%)
503 -> 48 (4.8%)
500 -> 3 (0.3%)
most 503s from model-worker-27: connection reset / kv-fetch-timeout
```

elaine: that aligns with the synthetic-kvprobe WARN. Could be a transient connection storm after the worker restart. Might be safe to let canary continue but we should stop promoting to prod until we confirm.

release-manager: suggestion: pin the /embed route to previous model binary (v3.13.9) in the routing policy for now, keep other routes on v3.14.0. That isolates blast radius and lets the rest of the rollout proceed. Thoughts?

samir: +1 for route-level pin. quick patch to routing table is trivial. If we need faster mitigation we can enable fallback-to-cold-pool for embed requests.

miguel: I can patch the routing policy. Applying pin now to embed-service -> model:v3.13.9 for 100% traffic. Will monitor synthetic.

deploy-bot: Routing policy change submitted: apply-route-pin embed-service -> v3.13.9 by miguel at 1779004370. Change-id: rp-20260320-9. Running verification probes.

sre-oncall: re-running synthetic-kvprobe after pin...```
embed probe (post-pin): 1000 reqs
200 -> 997 (99.7%)
503 -> 2 (0.2%)
500 -> 1 (0.1%)
```

elaine: nice — looks stable. How long do we keep the pin?

release-manager: keep for now until we confirm model-worker-27 root cause (likely cache config + restart cadence). Set a 4-hour hold and schedule a follow-up with eng-runtime.

samir: filing a ticket: INF-1247 - investigate model-worker-27 connection resets + cache TTL interplay. I'll include heap and connection metrics from the failure window.

miguel: will promote the rest of the rollout (non-embed routes) to prod. Leaving embed pinned until INF-1247 resolved.

deploy-bot: Note: rollout resumed for routes: text-gen, chat. embed route remains pinned to v3.13.9. Post-deploy smoke suite all green after pin. Marking thread resolved-if-no-objections. :white_check_mark:
